thm-every-smooth-vector-bundle-admits-a-.title: Every smooth vector bundle admits a connection
thm-every-smooth-vector-bundle-admits-a-.statement: Assume AC_omega as in the partition supplier.
thm-every-smooth-vector-bundle-admits-a-.proof_plan: Assume AC_omega as in the partition supplier. Choose a subordinate locally finite smooth partition and flat derivatives in its trivializations. Extend rho_i nabla^(i)s by zero outside the support and sum locally finitely. Leibniz gives (sum rho_i)df tensor s=df tensor s; do not differentiate weights. This proves existence, not a canonical connection.

fs-torsion-free-means-curvature-free.title: Torsion free means curvature free
fs-torsion-free-means-curvature-free.statement: Escalate the forward terminology: curvature is defined only on the later DG-21 page.
fs-torsion-free-means-curvature-free.proof_plan: Escalate the forward terminology: curvature is defined only on the later DG-21 page. Candidate local refutation uses g=exp(2x^2)(dx^2+dy^2): its symmetric Christoffels yield (nabla_x nabla_y-nabla_y nabla_x)partial_y=-2 partial_x at x=0. The curvature operator definition and invariance must be supplied locally before this fs or explicitly reconciled by the owner.
